test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

In spite of being seriously handicapped, Stephen Hawking __is one of most__ eminent modern scientists.
solution:
The correct answer is '**one of the most'*****.***

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Here the underlined word can be replaced by **one of the most.**
 
• **'one of' before 'the most' in superlative forms refers to something that is among a group of the most of quality**. 
 
• Here the adjective is 'eminent'.
 
• Because here the superlative degree of an adjective is used.
 
• So we should use the word *"**the"*** before the word *"**most"*** to correct the sentence.

**Correct Answer:**__ *In spite of being seriously handicapped, Stephen Hawking __is one of the most__ eminent modern scientists.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **It's also common to use 'one of' before 'the most' in superlative forms to refer to something that is among a group of the most of a quality**. The opposite of this form is 'one of the least (i.e. That is one of the least interesting films this year.)
